The Commercial Design Process

Five practical stages move the brief from business requirements to an approved, build-ready design.

1

Consultation & Requirements

We define the brand, customer experience, staff needs, budget and operational priorities.

2

Site Measurement

We record dimensions, services, access and any landlord or compliance conditions.

3

Concept & Layout Design

Footfall flow, staff workflow and the visual direction are tested together.

4

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, lighting and furniture are coordinated with the brand and daily use.

5

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Approved visuals and technical drawings prepare the space for pricing and execution.

Commercial Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. We issue an exact fixed quote once the space and scope are clear.

Commercial Interior FAQs

Clear answers on scope, timing, brand and working around an active business.

Commercial design balances brand, customer movement, staff workflow, durability and compliance. Residential design is shaped more closely around personal routines and comfort.

A focused office or retail design commonly takes two to four weeks. Larger hospitality, mall or multi-zone projects need a longer programme.

Yes. We translate brand colours, tone and customer experience into the layout, materials, signage and lighting.

Yes. We can prioritize reversible changes, landlord conditions and a clear return-to-shell strategy where needed.

Design reviews can be scheduled around operations. If Woodex also handles execution, phasing and out-of-hours work can be planned separately.

The package can include measured plans, space planning, concept boards, material and furniture selections, 3D visuals and working drawings.

Yes. Key areas are visualized in 3D so the layout, finishes and brand details can be approved before site work.

Woodex is based in Lahore and supports selected projects across Punjab and Pakistan.

fields.heading: Commercial Interior FAQs
fields.copy: Clear answers on scope, timing, brand and working around an active business.

items.q: How is commercial design different from residential design?
items.a: Commercial design balances brand, customer movement, staff workflow, durability and compliance. Residential design is shaped more closely around personal routines and comfort.

items.q: How long does commercial interior design take?
items.a: A focused office or retail design commonly takes two to four weeks. Larger hospitality, mall or multi-zone projects need a longer programme.
Yes. We translate brand colours, tone and customer experience into the layout, materials, signage and lighting.

items.q: Do you design for rented or leased spaces?
items.a: Yes. We can prioritize reversible changes, landlord conditions and a clear return-to-shell strategy where needed.

items.q: Can you work around business hours?
items.a: Design reviews can be scheduled around operations. If Woodex also handles execution, phasing and out-of-hours work can be planned separately.

items.q: What is included in the design package?
items.a: The package can include measured plans, space planning, concept boards, material and furniture selections, 3D visuals and working drawings.

items.q: Do I get 3D visuals before execution?
items.a: Yes. Key areas are visualized in 3D so the layout, finishes and brand details can be approved before site work.
Woodex is based in Lahore and supports selected projects across Punjab and Pakistan.
